sloka: मंदरम् पर्वत श्रेष्ठम् पाणिना हर्तुम् इच्छसि ।काल कूटम् विषम् पीत्वा स्वस्तिमान् गंतुम् इच्छसि ॥३-४७-४०॥
transliteration: maṁdaram parvata śreṣṭham pāṇinā hartum icchasi ।kāla kūṭam viṣam pītvā svastimān gaṁtum icchasi ॥3-47-40॥

translations.english: You are trying to carry the greatest of mountains, the Mandara, with one hand. You are wishing to go safe after drinking deadly poison (produced from the churning of the ocean).
